decisions.reason: This yogurt remains very close to the firm's core organic dairy knowledge and its earlier award plus several years of market presence suggest the firm can continue to learn from and exploit it commercially.
As a prominently positioned cheese variant built directly on established cheese-making capabilities, it fits the firm's knowledge base and strategic direction, making withdrawal unlikely.

The semi-hard cheese wheel is strongly related to the firm's existing cheese competence, and its continued survival indicates sufficient assimilated market knowledge, though its lower strategic visibility leaves some rationalisation risk.
This spicy cheese line extends familiar cheese and flavouring know-how and, with several models, offers continued scope for incremental learning and refinement rather than exit.

Washed-rind soft cheese still draws on the firm's related cheese expertise, but because it is somewhat more demanding in production control and consumer acceptance, it carries the highest remaining withdrawal risk among the kept products.
